description: Names the one security layer that needs attention (perimeter, holding, control, or continuity) and one next room, from enumerated answers. The answers are sent to the site to work out the result, and are not stored or logged. If the person asks for an explanation, the answers are also sent to an AI model provider, which is asked not to keep them. On the site's page, saved answers stay in the person's browser. What the calling agent keeps in its own history is outside the site's control. Deterministic and model-free. There is no score and it never certifies an arrangement as safe; other layers that also need attention are listed. It never accepts a seed, a key, a balance, an address, or identifying details. Questions: emailProtected (Is the email account behind your bitcoin accounts protected by a security key or an authenticator app, not text messages? "yes"|"no"|"unsure"); passwordManager (Do you use a password manager, with a different password for every account? "yes"|"no"|"unsure"); holding (Where is most of your bitcoin held? "exchange"|"single-key"|"multisig"|"unsure"); singleLoss (If one device or one seed backup were lost or stolen, could the bitcoin still be recovered, and still not be moved by whoever has it? "yes"|"no"|"unsure"); someoneCanRecover (If you could not act tomorrow, would the person taking over know how recovery should begin? "yes"|"no"|"unsure"); rehearsed (Have they walked through those steps with you? "yes"|"no").
name: check_security_posture
title: Check security posture
